An '''auxiliary battlegroup''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
An auxiliary battlegroup was an organizational formation only, with no assigned commander, and they were never deployed as a fighting force but instead as a [[Corps/Legends|corps]] resource. The battlegroup consisted of three [[COMPNOR Regiment]]s, and the corps [[ground support wing]]. It included 10,130 personnel, 390 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 40 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] of varying types.<ref name="ISB" />

Auxiliary battlegroups could be augmented by the addition of three [[line regiment]]s, and an [[assault regiment]].<ref name="ISB2" />
